name: io.github.wyre-technology/keeper-mcp
title: Keeper Secrets Manager
description: Read-only multitenant Streamable HTTP bridge over Keeper Secrets Manager's MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Public listen port for the bridge (POST /mcp, GET /health)

environmentVariables.name: KSM_MCP_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the upstream ksm-mcp binary the bridge spawns per tenant

environmentVariables.name: CHILD_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Writable HOME for upstream child processes

environmentVariables.name: IDLE_EVICT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Idle tenant timeout before an upstream child is evicted (ms)

environmentVariables.name: SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for a spawned child to answer the MCP handshake (ms)
